name: qa-distributed-tracing
description: Distributed tracing assertion testing: 6 skills (opentelemetry-trace-assertions, jaeger-trace-tests, zipkin-trace-tests, tempo-trace-tests, otel-collector-config-tester, trace-spec-author) and 1 agent (trace-coverage-reviewer). Asserts on production trace shape (spans, attributes, parent links, status), not just on aggregate metrics.
